name: Account Takeover and Money Mule Account Networks (Cyber Angle)
description: Criminals take over legitimate accounts through phishing, malware, credential stuffing and SIM swaps, or recruit and trick people into acting as money mules, in order to receive and move proceeds of cyber-enabled fraud. Networks of mule accounts layer funds quickly to cash-out channels, often across institutions.

sources.text: FinCEN, Advisory to Financial Institutions on Cyber-Events and Cyber-Enabled Crime (FIN-2016-A005, 2016)
FATF, Illicit Financial Flows from Cyber-Enabled Fraud (2023)
Europol, European Money Mule Action (EMMA) press releases (annual editions, e.g. EMMA 9, 2023)

exposure.rationale: Account takeover and mule accounts moving scam proceeds quickly to cash-out.

indicators.name: Credential, device or contact detail change followed by payments
indicators.canon: Credential or contact change followed by new payee and payments
indicators.desc: Password, email or phone details are changed, followed in the same session or day by a new payee and large outbound payments.
indicators.ctx: Password, email or phone change then new payee and payment in the same session or day.

indicators.name: Login from new device with remote-access tooling
indicators.canon: Remote-access, emulator or automation tools in session
indicators.desc: Remote-desktop, screen-sharing, emulator or scripted-control tools are detected during onboarding, login or payment sessions.
indicators.ctx: Session uses remote-desktop or screen-sharing applications at payment time.

indicators.name: Many failed logins across accounts from one source
indicators.canon: Multiple failed logins followed by success
indicators.desc: Repeated failed authentication attempts, often across accounts from one source, followed by successful access.
indicators.ctx: Credential stuffing pattern with later successful access.

indicators.name: Inbound funds quickly forwarded out in near-equal amounts
indicators.desc: Funds received into an account are forwarded onward within a very short period, often in near-equal amounts and leaving minimal balance.
indicators.ctx: Pass-through behaviour with minimal retained balance.

indicators.name: Recently opened account receiving payments from multiple unrelated victims
indicators.canon: Account receiving funds from multiple apparent fraud victims
indicators.desc: A new or low-activity account receives payments from several unrelated individuals who appear to be victims of fraud or phishing, followed by onward movement or cash-out.
indicators.ctx: New account collects scam receipts from varied sources.

indicators.name: Account holder profile mismatches activity
indicators.canon: Account activity inconsistent with declared occupation or income
indicators.desc: Turnover or volumes materially exceed what the customer's declared occupation, income, age or circumstances would support.
indicators.ctx: Student, pensioner or unemployed customer processes large flows.

indicators.name: Payments to crypto exchanges or cash-out channels soon after receipt
indicators.canon: Payments to crypto exchanges or cash-out channels soon after receipt
indicators.desc: Funds sent to exchanges, gift-card merchants or remittance providers immediately.
indicators.ctx: Funds sent to exchanges, gift-card merchants or remittance providers immediately.

indicators.name: Same beneficiary reached by many mule accounts
indicators.canon: Same beneficiary reached by many mule accounts
indicators.desc: Graph shows many accounts paying the same ultimate beneficiary.
indicators.ctx: Graph shows many accounts paying the same ultimate beneficiary.

indicators.name: Payee name verification fails or mismatches
indicators.canon: Payee name verification fails or mismatches
indicators.desc: Names mismatch or accounts recently created for the payee.
indicators.ctx: Names mismatch or accounts recently created for the payee.

indicators.name: Customer recruited online for fake job offering payment handling
indicators.canon: Customer recruited online for fake job offering payment handling
indicators.desc: Customer describes job ads asking to receive and forward funds.
indicators.ctx: Customer describes job ads asking to receive and forward funds.
